mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.sheet_id, d.product_id, d.order_num, d.tax_price, d.is_gift, d.tax_rate, d.description, d.order_no, d.return_num , d.production_date FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail AS d
mapper.select: SELECT d.product_id, d.tax_price / NULLIF(COALESCE(d.conversion_rate, 1), 0) AS tax_price, s.supplier_id FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail d INNER JOIN tbl_receive_sheet s ON d.sheet_id = s.id WHERE s.order_date >= #{beginDate} AND s.order_date <= #{orderDate} AND (d.product_id, s.order_date) IN ( -- 每个商品 取 最大order_date 的组合 SELECT product_id, MAX(order_date) AS order_date FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail d2 INNER JOIN tbl_receive_sheet s2 ON d2.sheet_id = s2.id WHERE s2.order_date >= #{beginDate} AND s2.order_date <= #{orderDate} GROUP BY d2.product_id) ORDER BY s.order_date DESC, d.product_id

SELECT d.product_id, SUM(d.tax_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(d.order_num), 0) AS tax_price FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail d INNER JOIN tbl_receive_sheet s ON d.sheet_id = s.id WHERE s.order_date >= #{beginDate} AND s.order_date <= #{endDate} AND d.is_gift = 0 GROUP BY d.product_id
